arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, time
# ~8MiB request: huge annotations (ignored) across many patch cells
cell = {"perturbed": 1, "ground_truth": "x"*200, "corrected": [1]*20, "confidence": {"k": "y"*100}}
counters = {"low_A_origination": cell, "low_A_termination": cell, "low_B_origination": cell,
            "low_B_termination": cell, "low_A_egress_to_B": cell, "low_B_ingress_from_A": cell,
            "low_B_egress_to_A": cell, "low_A_ingress_from_B": cell}
topo = {"nodes":[{"id":0,"name":"A","external_capacity":100},{"id":1,"name":"B","external_capacity":100}],
        "links":[{"source":0,"target":1,"capacity":100}],"external_nodes":["A","B"]}
S = {"trials":2,"epsilon":0,"seed":7,"cutoff":[0,1],"bias":0,"tau":0,"gamma":[1,1],"cache_slots":2}
events = []
size = 0
while size < 7_800_000:
    events.append({"op":"patch","demands":[[0,1,10],[1,0,3]],"counters":counters})
    size += len(json.dumps(events[-1]))
events.append({"op":"repair","id":"big"})
req = {"streams":[{"topology":topo,"settings":S,"events":events}]}
raw = json.dumps(req, separators=(",",":")).encode()
print("events:", len(events), "bytes:", len(raw))
t0 = time.time()
r = subprocess.run(["/usr/local/bin/python3","-B","-u","/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=raw,
                   capture_output=True, cwd="/workspace/tmp")
t1 = time.time()
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[:500]
out = json.loads(r.stdout)
assert out["streams"][0]["events"][-1]["op"] == "repair"
assert all(e == {"op":"patch","accepted":True} for e in out["streams"][0]["events"][:-1])
print("wall seconds:", round(t1-t0, 2))
EOF
